response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT r.ordervault AS ordervault, o.orderflow AS orderflow, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY r.ordervault, o.orderflow), s AS (SELECT ordervault, orderflow, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY orderflow) AS share FROM c), d AS (SELECT ordervault, orderflow, cnt, share, share - AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY orderflow) AS diff FROM s), f AS (SELECT * FROM d WHERE share > share - diff), k AS (SELECT ordervault, orderflow, cnt, share, diff, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY diff DESC) AS rk FROM f) SELECT ordervault, orderflow, cnt AS record_count, share, diff AS share_minus_status_avg FROM k WHERE rk <= 10 ORDER BY diff DESC

assumptions.assumption: Share is computed as a fraction (0-1) using floating-point division; the average share is taken over all combinations per status before filtering to those above average. Filtering uses diff > 0, written as share > share - diff.
Ties with the 10th row are included via RANK() <= 10 on the difference.
orders.recordvault is treated as unique per order, so each ordervault has one orderflow.
